name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v559: real fix for the Android TV crash. CloudStream loads plugins with PathClassLoader(pluginFile, appClassLoader), which checks the app's own dex first. The TV's CloudStream APK contains its own com.megix.settings.SettingsWebView (app/src/main/java/com/megix/settings/SettingsWebView.kt plus a 5-second auto-bypass popup in MainActivity), so that old copy shadowed the plugin's class and the plugin's SettingsDialog linked against the wrong shape - hence NoSuchFieldError INSTANCE in base.apk!classes7.dex. v559 renames the plugin's solver to com.megix.settings.CineStreamSolverUi, which the APK does not contain, so the plugin now always resolves its own class. Every solver call is also guarded by a Throwable catch so a linkage problem can never kill the app. All v556-v558 behaviour retained: invisible mode only falls back to visible at app open, kwik.cx challenges fail silently, pre-playback probe validates the mirror holding the cookie, isCookieValid retries transient interstitials, pre-purge clearance snapshot prevents stale cookie saves.
